content: Postgres SELECT FOR UPDATE blocks concurrent updaters (safe for exact-row atomicity, e.g. row-locking a resource/slot row); SKIP LOCKED skips locked rows entirely, good for queue-pop patterns but wrong for booking capacity checks since it would let a request 'skip' the contended row and read stale capacity. SERIALIZABLE isolation catches capacity races via app-level retry on serialization failure but adds retry-loop complexity.
